rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Residential rental property owners are prohibited from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices, and software providers are prohibited from facilitating price coordination among competing landlords.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property owners and software providers using algorithmic revenue management software, excluding publicly available tools, spreadsheets requiring human analysis, traditional listing databases, and government-administered affordable housing programs.

rules.exemptions: The act does not prohibit the use of certain technologies, including spreadsheets requiring human analysis, publicly available rent estimation tools, traditional real estate listing databases, and government-administered affordable housing programs.
rules.quoted_span: The FAIR Act prohibits residential rental property owners from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices.
